item.title: In the second half Dallas Maverick lose by Memphis 133-104
item.description:
In the second half Dallas Maverick lose by Memphis 133-104

Dallas Maverick – There are just three games left in the customary NBA season, however even after a misfortune (an appalling, monstrous misfortune) Tuesday night the Dallas Mavericks actually get an opportunity.

Ja Morant had 24 focuses, eight helps and seven bounce back as the Memphis Grizzlies utilized a second from last quarter burst to beat the Mavs 133-104.
